relations.subject: Supermicro
relations.quote: We work with Ablecom, one of our key contract manufacturers and a related party, for our chassis and certain other components.

relations.subject: Supermicro
relations.quote: We also outsource a significant part of the manufacturing of certain components, particularly power supplies, to Compuware, also a related party.

relations.subject: Supermicro
relations.quote: Compuware also serves as a non-exclusive authorized distributor of our products and, from time to time, as our sales representative.

relations.subject: Supermicro
relations.quote: Global assembly, test and quality control of our servers are performed at our manufacturing facilities in San Jose, California, Taiwan, the Netherlands, and Malaysia.
